hotspots.name: The Third Door
hotspots.description: No sign, no window, and a man behind it who deals in the things the Church has a list for. He does not ask what you are, and the not-asking is the service.

hotspots.name: The Papered Door
hotspots.description: Bills pasted over bills: a prizefight, a sailing, and three hand-written cards offering good prices for books, papers and 'curiosities of the older sort, discretion assured'.

hotspots.name: Churned Mud
hotspots.description: Cart tracks, boot prints, and one clean rectangle where something the size of a book lay in the wet long enough to keep the rain off the ground beneath it.
